translations.web: Therefore when he comes into the world, he says, “You didn’t desire sacrifice and offering, but you prepared a body for me.
translations.bsb: Therefore, when Christ came into the world, He said: “Sacrifice and offering You did not desire, but a body You prepared for Me.
translations.kjv: Wherefore when he cometh into the world, he saith, Sacrifice and offering thou wouldest not, but a body hast thou prepared me:
